text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
"Actually, an acquaintance at a shop over there
gave me a whole bunch of rice crackers."

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
They're fresh out of the oven and crispy, and
since they aren't individually wrapped in bags,
they won't keep for very long.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Could you take some off my hands?

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: Thank you very much. Bon appétit.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
It's delicious... Truly...
It's been grilled with such incredible care...

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trainer.
...Someone gave me these rice crackers.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: If we don't eat it soon, the flavor might fade away...

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Trainer,
is it alright if I eat all of this?

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: Rice crackers have such an honest, simple flavor that I always end up eating too many.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Whenever I went to my grandparents' house,
I'd end up eating an entire bag all by myself...

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Let us leave it at this for today, though. Tomorrow will bring
a flavor of even greater depth, I believe.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
—Yes.
It really is best to eat them
while they're fresh out of the oven, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: Well then, since you're offering, I won't hold back.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
I think Acute-san would be happier
if you ate the ones she gave you right away.
